summary: Suncor Energy filed a Form 6-K announcing planned executive leadership changes. CEO Rich Kruger will transition to Executive Vice Chair in April 2027, with Peter Zebedee, currently EVP Upstream, assuming CEO then. Zebedee becomes President and CFO on September 14, 2026, gaining oversight of non-operating functions. Additional ELT changes: Adam Albeldawi becomes EVP Upstream; Shelley Powell becomes EVP Development and Projects. The succession follows a rigorous board-led process. No financial terms, advisors, or deal mechanics are disclosed. This is a planned, orderly transition, not a forced departure; watch for future strategy continuity and execution of Suncor's growth plan.
